items.title: Angola Talking Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Jim Jackson was around that a lot, too.

ctx.x: Yeah. You know, Cannon's Jug Stompers? Memphis Jug Band they used to have around there. Oh, yeah. Yeah, true. It's true. Yes, sir. Yes, sir. Oh, they had some wonderful bands. Say that again. Jim Jackson was around that a lot, too. That's right. Yeah. And what year were you born? 1896. And the date is that? Yep, May. 5th of May, 1896.…

I don't have any money, but just the way it sounds. I don't have any money, but just the way it sounds. We'll get it another time. That's right. I really had a sweet man. One of my boys, one of the main hitter boy, got it on. He shot off one that he left on. And so I got another boy, and he sold all the instruments. Sold all the equipment. Sold them on Saturday, on Friday night, we went to go outside the morning and a.m. ever. So the fire was getting on. And everything was going to bring in so many. I got a…
